message:
test(rel-0164): old-APK lane r7i -- the keyboard is judged by what is on screen: mInputShown and the IME window's own visibility; mIsInputViewShown alone is the IME's internal flag, noted, not judged

On ff1c72a (the verifier's r7h). Verifier run oa-s-20261030072336-44052 1b FAIL: before BACK [mDecorViewVisible,
mInputShown, mIsInputViewShown, mWindowVisible] true, after BACK only [mIsInputViewShown]; fail1_screen.png showed no
keyboard, and the run's logcat agrees -- 22:24:54.443 ImeTracker onRequestHide ORIGIN_SERVER_HIDE_INPUT reason
HIDE_SOFT_INPUT_BY_BACK_KEY, GoogleInputMethodService.onFinishInputView(), 22:24:54.916 (app) ImeTracker onHidden.
AOSP: InputMethodService.hideWindow() clears mWindowVisible / mDecorViewVisible; mIsInputViewShown is the IME's "the
input view would be shown" evaluation (updateInputViewShown / onEvaluateInputViewShown) and is not cleared by it;
InputMethodManagerService.mInputShown is the system's "the IME is shown". (Source reading; the run kept no raw dumpsys.)

ime_state: shown = any of mInputShown / mWindowVisible / mDecorViewVisible true; hidden = all three read and false
(mIsInputViewShown true alone noted as IME-internal only, in the verdict line); unknown = a flag missing / unclear
(fail-closed: no tap). Every read's FLAG LINES only are kept in <out>/ime_reads.txt (nothing else of the dump).
Stricter than r7d in one case: mInputShown=false read alone (the window flags missing) was hidden, now unknown.

Tests (stub): oa_pick_test 74/74 -- the run's pattern -> hidden (noted); all on -> shown; mInputShown false but the
window visible -> shown; half read -> unknown; nothing -> unknown; 1b with the run's after-BACK pattern -> PASS (flag
noted, the flag lines kept); ff1c72a on the same pattern -> 1b FAIL (the run reproduced); 4 with a half read -> no tap;
4 with the run's pattern -> the tap goes. The fake gains the internal / windowonly / partial dumps and a BACK that
leaves the internal flag. No real run.
